header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: O believers! Remember Allah with abundant remembrance, and glorify Him morning and evening.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالَي: (إِنَّ اللهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلي النَّبِيِّ ؕ يآأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ امَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيماً۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Indeed Allah sends His mercy upon this Prophet, and the angels also seek mercy for him; (so) O believers, send Salawat upon him, and send Salam (upon him) in a goodly manner.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا فَاحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا اللهَ فَاسْتَغْفَرُوا لِذُنُوبِهِمْ قف وَمَنْ يَّغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللهَ قف وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا عَلي مَا فَعَلُوا وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ ۞ أُولئِكَ جَزَآءُهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمْ وَجَنّتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا اْلاَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ؕ وَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعمِلِينَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And they are those who, when they commit something shameful or wrong themselves, (immediately) remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins; and who forgives sins except Allah? And they do not knowingly persist in the (sin) they have done. Such are they - their reward is forgiveness from their Rabb and gardens beneath which rivers flow; (they) will abide therein forever - (thus) the reward of those who do good deeds is excellent indeed.
